title: L_p-Rogers--Shephard type inequalities for L_p-zonoids and symmetric bodies
summary: We study generalizations of the classical Rogers--Shephard inequalities in the framework of Firey $L_p$-summation. We first consider the class of asymmetric $L_p$-zonoids. In this setting, we show that proving a sharp $L_p$-Rogers--Shephard inequality for asymmetric $L_p$-zonoids in $\mathbb{R}^n$ is equivalent to proving a sharp inequality between the volumes of projections of $B_q^m\cap \mathbb{R}^m_+$ and $B_q^m$ onto an $n$-dimensional subspace $E$, where $q$ is the Hölder conjugate of $p$.
